entries.summary: new remark: Flight below 1000 feet AGL is prohibited except in the pattern over Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary.
entries.original: FLT BELOW 1000 FT AGL PROHIBITED EXC IN PAT OVER MONTEREY BAY NATIONAL MARINE SANCTUARY.

entries.summary: new remark: Caution regarding agricultural operations, occasional irrigation on turf and people using dirt roads adjacent to runway; recommend overflying airfield to observe operations adjacent to runway before landing; straight-in approach not advised.
entries.original: CTN REGARDING AGRICULTURAL OPS, OCNL IRRIGATION ON TURF AND PEOPLE USING DIRT ROADS ADJ TO RWY.  RCMD OVERFLYING AIRFIELD TO OBS OPS ADJ TO RWY BFR LDG.  SI APCH NOT ADVISED.

entries.summary: new remark: Permission for landings is required; see additional contact information for liability release form.
entries.original: PMSN FOR LDGS RQRD.  SEE ADDNL CTC FOR LIABILITY RLS FORM.

entries.summary: new remark: Uncrewed aircraft system activity is ongoing from the surface to 10000 feet MSL; check NOTAMs.
entries.original: ONGOING UAS ACT FROM SFC TO 10000 FT MSL.  CHECK NOTAMS.

entries.summary: remark removed: Caution regarding agricultural operations and for people and animals using dirt roads adjacent to both sides of turf strip; recommend overflying airfield to observe operations adjacent to runway before landing.
entries.original: CAUTION REGARDING AGRICULTURAL OPERATIONS AND FOR PEOPLE AND ANIMALS USING DIRT ROADS ADJACENT TO BOTH SIDES OF TURF STRIP. RECOMMEND OVERFLYING AIRFIELD TO OBSERVE OPERATIONS ADJACENT TO RUNWAY BEFORE LANDING.

entries.summary: remark removed: Grass is occasionally irrigated from late afternoon until sunrise.
entries.original: OCCASIONAL IRRIGATION ON TURF FROM LATE AFTERNOON TO SUNRISE.

entries.summary: remark removed: Permission for landings is offered after visitors sign and submit a liability release form available online at the Monterey Bay Academy website.
entries.original: PMSN FOR LDGS IS OFFERED AFTER VISITORS SIGN AND SMT A LIABILITY RLS FORM AVBL ONLINE AT THE MONTEREY BAY ACADEMY WEBSITE.

entries.summary: remark removed: Review additional operating recommendations at WWW.OCEANSHOREAVIATION.COM.
entries.original: PLEASE REVIEW ADDITIONAL OPERATING RECOMMENDATIONS AT WWW.OCEANSHOREAVIATION.COM

entries.summary: remark removed: Use caution for NOAA overflight restriction areas throughout the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary, which prohibit flights below 1,000 feet AGL except in the pattern.
entries.original: USE CAUTION CONCERNING NOAA OVER FLIGHT RESTRICTION AREAS, THROUGHOUT THE MONTEREY BAY NATIONAL MARINE SANCTUARY, PROHIBITING FLIGHTS BELOW 1,000 FT AGL EXCEPT IN PATTERN.
